description: Count working days from start to end for one country. A working day is Monday to Friday and not a national public holiday. Saturday and Sunday are weekends, the same rule as the planner. Regional holidays are not skipped. include_start and include_end work the same way as days_between and default to false. Holiday dates are the bundled vacanza/holidays list (MIT) for 2026, 2027, and 2028. A date outside those years returns an error naming the missing year, instead of guessing. The result lists the national holidays inside the counted span, including the local name.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or English country name. UK is accepted for the United Kingdom.

include_end.description: Count end when it is a working day. Default false.

include_start.description: Count start when it is a working day. Default false.

name: working_days_between

alternatives.description: Other cities that matched the same name, after the best-ranked city was chosen. The order is the site search order: match, then priority, then population.

title: Working days between two dates
